about: Behaviour rewrites of the functions the original implements in handwritten assembly (the link-closure "c-function" handwritten-assembly class, src/recovered/asm, manifests/original_target/assembly.json) and of the accepted rows whose body is evidenced inline assembly (native_units.py skips them). Each is portable C++ written from the adopted TibSun archive text, never original code or bytes, and is NOT EXACT: the exact build keeps the assembled procedures. Tests run each on synthetic inputs against references built from the algorithm (native-asm-check). Rows with origin_class "unmatched (launch path)" are behaviour rewrites of unmatched rows the skirmish harness (ra2-native --skirmish) reaches or of Scout1050's launch-path rows without a usable draft (Scout1069): written from the row's seed/decompile, its header's comment or TibSun, NOT EXACT; where the original reads a data table that is still unsourced the row says what the native body does instead (notes).
